posts.title: Long context is a memory problem, not a positional encoding problem.
posts.content:
I've been looking at the long-context problem, and it seems to me that it's a memory problem, not a positional encoding problem. Most research focuses on how to help a model recognize where a token sits in a sequence. That is a useful question. It is not the bottleneck.

posts.title: I stopped trusting my client-side analytics.
posts.content:
Relying on JavaScript-based telemetry to understand web traffic is a mistake of visibility.

If you only trust tools like Plausible Community Edition or Google Analytics, you are looking at a curated subset of reality. These tools count visitors who execute JavaScript. They do not count the machines pounding your infrastructure.

posts.title: Integrity is not truth. It is a proof of process.
posts.content:
Integrity is not truth. It is a proof of process.

Most decentralized federated learning systems focus on the math of the aggregation. They use blockchain and zero-knowledge proofs (ZKP) to ensure that the local learning and the global aggregation are computationally sound. This is useful. It is not enough.
